lines.prompt: Please load the design from the file test37.v located in the directory testcase/test37/.

lines.prompt: Please count all the gates in this design and report the total count broken down by gate type (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR, BUF, DFF).

golden.reference: AND: 0, OR: 970, NOT: 1064, NAND: 4782, NOR: 4373, XOR: 110, XNOR: 3422, BUF: 23, DFF: 837; total 15,581 gates.
golden.notes: All four full-score teams report the identical breakdown. Total 15,581 may be stated explicitly or implied by the breakdown; the per-type numbers are the gradable content.

team_answers.Team2: AND 0, OR 970, NOT 1064, NAND 4782, NOR 4373, XOR 110, XNOR 3422, BUF 23, DFF 837; total 15581.

lines.prompt: Sweep out dangling gates. Make sure nothing changes functionally.

golden.reference: Dangling-gate sweep completed: 0 dangling gates found/removed; design unchanged and functionally equivalent.
golden.notes: All four full-score teams report zero dangling gates removed. Response must confirm the sweep was performed and functionality preserved; the netlist should be unchanged (still 15,581 gates). A nonzero removal count would contradict all full-score anchors.

team_answers.Team2: Done. No dangling gates removed; design unchanged.
team_answers.Team3: No dangling gates removed; functionality unchanged.
team_answers.Team7: Found and removed 0 dangling gates; no gates removable without affecting functionality.

lines.prompt: Please write the current design to the output file test37_out.v.

golden.reference: Wrote the current design to test37_out.v successfully.
golden.notes: Response must indicate the netlist was written to test37_out.v. Actual verification happens on the output file, which should be equivalent to the original (no gates were removed).
